info.title: Model Dock inference API
info.description: Local gateway for project-authorized models. Chat Completions and Responses accept text and images and return text. The image generation endpoint supports a Model Dock reference editing extension. Use the gateway origin and full paths below. The OpenAI SDK base URL ends in /v1.

servers.description: Default gateway origin. Use your gateway origin when running on another port.

get.description: Lists available, published models and legacy aliases authorized for the supplied key. Capability values can be unknown. The catalog is a metadata lookup.

200.description: Authorized model catalog. An empty data array is valid.

post.description: Chat with text or image input and optional streaming, function calls and structured output. Image parts are accepted in user messages, including history, subject to the model's capabilities. The gateway cancels upstream work on disconnect.

textParts.summary: One choice from ordered text parts

Return a JSON object with a greeting.

200.description: JSON completion by default. Requests with stream true receive server-sent events.

message.refusal: I cannot help with that request.

schema.description: Each data frame holds a JSON chunk, a JSON error envelope, or [DONE]. Text and refusal deltas stream as received. Complete tool calls are sent in one chunk after validation and before the tool_calls finish reason. With include_usage enabled, regular chunks carry usage: null followed by a final usage chunk with empty choices if counters are known. A provider failure after streaming starts uses an error envelope and closes without [DONE].

post.description: Create a JSON or streamed text response from text or images. The caller supplies conversation history and holds the response items. Tool-capable OpenAI-compatible API, Ollama and Codex models can hand off up to one application function per request. The gateway cancels inference on disconnect.

200.description: A JSON Response object or named server-sent events. Inspect the terminal status for the output or the reason it ended early.

schema.description: Named events with matching type and increasing sequence_number in data. Each item is added before any content or argument events. Function arguments arrive in a single delta after validation. The terminal event is response.completed, response.incomplete, or response.failed. A connection that closes without a terminal event has an unknown outcome.

post.summary: Generate an image or edit references
post.description: Returns a single Base64 image from a published Codex image model. Use images.generate() with an OpenAI SDK for basic generation. Reference-based editing uses the Model Dock reference_images extension on this JSON endpoint. The standard /v1/images/edits endpoint returns 404.

value.prompt: Keep the subject from image 1 and change its color to green.

200.description: One image. The response reports its actual pixel dimensions and encoding.

bearerAuth.description: Use a scoped Model Dock project key for SDK and application calls. The local administrator token or an active console session also authenticates local inference.

RequestId.description: Opaque Model Dock request ID for troubleshooting. Correlate it with the gateway request history when present.

RetryAfter.description: For connection_busy, 2 seconds. For upstream_rate_limited, the valid upstream delay in seconds or IMF-fixdate when provided. Codex quota errors can omit this header.

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON, unsupported parameters, or provider request rejection. Invalid image bytes or MIME types use invalid_image_input. Models that declare no image support return unsupported_model_capability. Codex uses context_length_exceeded for context limits and codex_bad_request for native bad requests. Check error.param when provided.

Unauthorized.description: No valid bearer token or the key was revoked during the request.

Forbidden.description: The key lacks model access, or the request is rejected by the local Host or Origin check.

ModelUnavailable.description: The requested model is unknown, disabled, or unavailable to execute.

Conflict.description: The connection was removed during inference or the chat reasoning policy needs to be updated.

TooLarge.description: The JSON body or the decoded image references exceed a size limit.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Send a JSON body with Content-Type application/json.

RateLimited.description: Gateway capacity or provider quota. Use the code to identify the source.

error.message: This connection is at capacity. Retry after the active request finishes.

Cancelled.description: An administrator cancelled the active request. When the client disconnects it cannot read a response.

InternalError.description: Unexpected gateway error. Use the request ID to investigate.

UpstreamError.description: Provider authentication, connection, protocol, output, or model runtime failure. Codex uses codex_protocol_error for missing or inconsistent answer text.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Gateway shutting down or native Codex image generation currently unavailable.

Timeout.description: The configured provider deadline elapsed. The provider outcome may be unknown.

id.description: Use the full ID in subsequent calls. Native IDs include the connection prefix.

created.description: The source creation time is unspecified.

context_window.description: Reported token context window. A null value means unknown.

reasoning_efforts.description: Model levels exposed by the current publication policy.

image_input.description: Accepts image input for text inference. A null value means the provider has not declared support.

model.description: Authorized full model ID or a legacy alias.

n.description: A request always returns one choice, even when n is omitted.

stream_options.description: Set include_usage to true to request a final chunk with reported counters. Regular chunks then carry usage: null.

tool_choice.description: Ollama accepts auto and none. The required mode needs at least one function in tools. A named choice must match a function in tools.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Set false for a limit of one function call per turn. OpenAI-compatible upstreams may support true. Ollama and Codex accept false or omission.

reasoning_effort.description: Availability and default depend on the model and publication policy.

ChatRequest.description: Requests return one choice and accept strings or ordered content parts. Only user messages may contain images. Provider support varies by field and model. Undeclared fields are rejected.

content.description: Pure text parts are joined in order without inserting delimiters. Images can be interleaved with text in user messages, including history. An assistant tool-call message may omit content.

tool_call_id.description: ID of the matching pending tool call.

ChatHistoryMessage.description: Supply a tool result for every call before the next ordinary message. Function call IDs must be unique throughout the history.

ImageDataUrl.description: A standard Base64 data URL with matching PNG, JPEG or WebP data.

parameters.description: JSON Schema for the function input.

arguments.description: A serialized JSON object. Validate application-specific arguments before calling the function.

ChatResponseFormat.description: For completed responses with finish_reason stop, the gateway checks JSON syntax and requires a top-level object in json_object mode. Upstream handles schema constraints. Refusals have a dedicated field.

refusal.description: Explicit model refusal when reported by the provider.

usage.description: Omitted when the provider does not report complete counters.

tool_calls.description: Contains the complete, validated batch, emitted before finish_reason: tool_calls.

model.description: Authorized full model ID or a legacy alias.

input.description: A user prompt or ordered, self-contained history. Resend images in their original user messages. Function results reference a preceding function call by call_id. Include all results before adding the next message.

instructions.description: Prepend these instructions to the text history for this request.

store.description: The client supplies history for each request.

tool_choice.description: Ollama supports auto and none. The other adapters also accept required and named functions, subject to the model.

parallel_tool_calls.description: At most one function can be handed off in a turn.

id.description: Optional item ID accepted when replaying output.

parsed.description: SDK-derived field accepted for input replay and ignored.
SDK-derived field accepted for input replay and ignored.

strict.description: Omission or null selects false. An explicit true requires support from the OpenAI-compatible upstream.

id.description: Output item ID used by streaming events.

call_id.description: Use this value in the function_call_output item.

arguments.description: JSON-encoded object. The initial streamed item has an empty arguments string.

status.description: For replay, omit status or use completed.

parsed_arguments.description: SDK-derived field accepted for input replay and ignored.

call_id.description: Matches the call_id of the completed function_call in the replayed input.

output.description: Tool result as plain text or serialized JSON.

id.description: Opaque response and gateway request ID.

usage.description: Reported token counts, or null when unavailable. No estimates or inferred breakdowns.

model.description: Full ID of an authorized Codex image model.

prompt.description: The gateway counts UTF-16 code units. Refer to attachments by their order starting at 1.

aspect_ratio.description: Requested canvas ratio. Omit it to let Codex choose.

background.description: Requests that Codex choose a background or attempt transparency.

reference_images.description: Ordered PNG, JPEG or WebP Base64 data URLs. The declared MIME type must match the decoded image. The decoded limit is 30 MiB per image and 50 MiB total.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. New codes may be added.
